manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a ball tossed vertically to a ball released from rest at its apex to see why velocity zero does not mean acceleration is zero.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes display a tossed ball and a dropped ball. The dropped ball is held by a gate at the toss apex until the top, then released. Vectors show velocity and acceleration.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
